slides.texte_overlay:
what people notice about
you in the first 7 seconds

your posture

before you say a word, people read how you stand. shoulders back and chin level tell everyone you're comfortable, and that quiet calm is wonderfully contagious.

your eyes

people notice whether you look at them or away. a relaxed, warm look for a second longer than usual feels like interest, and it makes people trust you.

your pace

people pick up on whether you rush or move calmly. walking and speaking a little slower than everyone else reads as quiet confidence almost instantly.

your curiosity

people notice when someone seems genuinely interested in the world. 5 minutes a day learning something new, a planet or a painting, shows up in how you talk and listen.
slides.texte_sophia:
your curiosity

people notice genuine curiosity. i spend 5 minutes a day on one lesson in the Sophia app: a planet, a painting, a moment in history. it shows up in how i talk and listen.

slides.texte_overlay:
your hands

people notice what your hands are doing. open, relaxed hands look honest and calm, while hidden or fidgeting hands make people feel a little more guarded.
